scripts.dev: concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n server,app,admin,ngrok -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:server" "wait-on tcp:18080 && pnpm dev:app" "wait-on tcp:18080 && pnpm dev:admin" "wait-on tcp:13000 && pnpm dev:app:tunnel"
scripts.dev:app:tunnel: sh -c 'ngrok config check >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec ngrok http 13000; echo "[ngrok] skipped: run ngrok config add-authtoken <token> to enable mobile tunnel"; exec tail -f /dev/null'
